ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, irregular high-intensity (white) regions occupy the central-medial portion of each lobe. Low-intensity (dark) pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and notch, with heavy mottling concentrated near the tips and the left-central white patch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex angle of approximately 30 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1.2:1.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (3 to 12 pixels) along the entire trailing edge; most prominent near the distal tips where they form deep, jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a strong convex curve sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of dark, low-intensity pixel blobs concentrated at the lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface encrustations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, dark linear pixel chains (scratches) visible on the white high-intensity background of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular tissue accumulations at both lobe tips, creating a 'lumpy' 2D silhouette that disrupts the smooth flow of the trailing edge.
